item.title: What the EU's greenwashing rules ban, claim by claim
item.description: Since 27 September 2026 some green claims are unlawful in the EU whatever the context: generic eco-friendly wording, carbon-neutral claims built on offsets, self-made sustainability labels. What is banned outright, what needs proof, and how the UK and US rules compare.
